lead: Meena Kumari was an actor, born on 1 August 1933 in Dadar.
She died on 31 March 1972 in Mumbai at the age of 38.
She has 56 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Actress and Bengal Film Journalists' Association Awards.
This profile collects the Meena facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Meena Kumari — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Meena Kumari was born on 1 August 1933 in Dadar, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India. She was given the name महजबी बानो at birth and is publicly known as Meena Kumari.
She is a sibling of Khursheed Bano.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
